senses.gloss: palm of the hand, hand.—Du. כַּפַּיִם. Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ bot., v. חָטַף.
units: Naz. 46ᵇ, v. כָּנָף; a. fr.—נשא כ׳ to raise the hands, to pronounce the priestly benediction.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:4">Ber. V, 4</cite> <he>לא ישא את כַּפָּיו</he> must not pronounce &c.; a. fr.
Ḥull. 70ᵇ מהלכי כ׳ animals walking on soles (having no split hoofs, Lev. XI, 27).—Trnsf. glove; sole of the shoe.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:3">Kel. XXVI, 3</cite> <he>כף לוקטי</he>(<he>ם</he>) <he>קוצים</he> (R. S. <he>כפלוקטי</he>) the thorn-pickers’ glove.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 5</cite> <he>רוב כף אחת</he>, the larger portion of one sole; <he>כל כף אחת</he> the whole of &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:4">Tosef. Nidd. VI, 4</cite>, sq. <he>עד שתפשט את הכף</he> (Var. <he>משתתפשט</he>) when the crest (of the girl) begins to flatten; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:2:7">Y. Yeb. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עד שתתפשט הכף</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:1:2">Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>משתתפשט הכ׳</he> (of a male); <cite ref="Niddah 47a">Nidd. 47ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>נתמעך הכ׳</he> the crest grows lower.
<cite ref="Niddah 52b:6">Ib. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>אחת על הכ׳</he> one hair on the crest; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 7:2">Ib. VII, 2</cite> <he>כף וכסויה</he> the censer and its lid; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="K01003"><he>כַּפּוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:18">Num. R. s. 14</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:2">Kel. XIII, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:4">4</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:7">ib. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ של סיידין</he> the plasterers’ trowel.—Pl. <he>כַּפִּים</he>, <cite ref="K01016"><he>כַּפִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:4">Midd. III, 4</cite> <he>כפין של ברזל</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="K01018"><he>כפיס</he></cite>, Var. <he>כפים</he>) iron trowels.

senses.gloss: (with, or without מאזנים) scale of the balance.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ab. II, 8</cite>. Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 167ᵃ <he>כ׳ עוונות וכ׳</he> the scale of sins on the one side, and that of merits on the other; <he>והקב״ה מטה לכ׳ זכות</he> and the Lord bends (the balance) towards the scale of merits.
Ab. I, 6, v. זְכוּת; a. fr.—Du. כַּפַּיִים, כַּפַּיִין.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 5</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>כיפין</he>, read: <he>כפיין</he>).

Ḥăn. 3) (transl. <he>גיא המלח</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 25:11">II Chr. XXV, 11</cite>) <he>כ׳ המלח</he> the salt shores.
